author: Arnav
problem: Read a string of lowercase 'v' and 'w' characters. A 'v' has 1 bottom point and a 'w' has 2; print the total number of bottom points.
bug_description: Compares with uppercase 'W', which never appears, so every 'w' counts as 1.

comments.accurate: Counts 2 for each w and 1 for each v
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts 2 for each capital W and 1 for every other letter
comments.wrong_location: Letter weights verified; check the input is split into single characters
